# Joshua C. Yang

Joshua C. Yang researches democratic technology, collective decision making, participatory budgeting, deliberation, voting systems, civic AI, and multi-agent LLM deliberation.

## Main Pages

- Website: {{ site.url }}/
- Publications: {{ site.url }}/pubs/
- Projects: {{ site.url }}/projects/
- CV: {{ site.url }}/cv/

## Publications

- Belief Engine: Configurable and Inspectable Stance Dynamics in Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation: {{ site.url }}/pubs/belief-engine/
  Auditable belief updating for multi-agent LLM deliberation, with structured memory, evidence uptake, prior anchoring, and human DEBATE replay validation.
- LLM Voting: Human Choices and AI Collective Decision Making: {{ site.url }}/pubs/llm-voting/
  Empirical comparison of GPT-4 Turbo and LLaMA-2 voting behavior against human participatory budgeting choices, including order effects, personas, chain-of-thought, and temperature.
- Komitee Equal Shares: A Hybrid Algorithm for Priceable Participatory Funding: {{ site.url }}/pubs/komitee-equal-shares/
  Field-tested participatory funding algorithm from Winterthur combining voter preferences, impact-field evaluation, Method of Equal Shares, priceability, and voting receipts.
- Designing Digital Voting Systems for Citizens: Achieving Fairness and Legitimacy in Participatory Budgeting: {{ site.url }}/pubs/designing-digital-voting-systems/
- Bridging Voting and Deliberation with Algorithms: Field Insights from vTaiwan and Kultur Komitee: {{ site.url }}/pubs/bridging-voting-deliberation/
  Hybrid democratic innovation paper on preference-based clustering, human-in-the-loop Method of Equal Shares, ReadTheRoom opinion mapping, vTaiwan, and Kultur Komitee.
- Upgrading Democracies with Fairer Voting Methods: {{ site.url }}/pubs/upgrading-democracies-fairer-voting/
- Democracy by Design: Perspectives for Digitally Assisted, Participatory Upgrades of Society: {{ site.url }}/pubs/democracy-by-design/
- Democratizing Traffic Control in Smart Cities: {{ site.url }}/pubs/democratizing-traffic-control/
- Exploring Legitimacy in a Municipal Budget Decision in Switzerland: {{ site.url }}/pubs/exploring-legitimacy-swiss-budget/
- A Taxonomy for Blockchain-Based Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Networks (DePIN): {{ site.url }}/pubs/depin-taxonomy/
- Respeaking for Word-Spotting as a Collaborative Transcription Method for Oral Languages: {{ site.url }}/pubs/respeaking-word-spotting/
